name: platform-foundations
description: Shared Platform foundation for PlainConcepts Platform apps: theme, conventions, docs, and a themed component showcase.

scripts.release:theme: pnpm typecheck && cd packages/theme && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:components: pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @plainconceptsplatform/ui-components build && cd packages/ui-components && npm publish --access public
